dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 20, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tigers Take Down White Sox in Detroit**

The Detroit Tigers handed the Chicago White Sox a 4-1 loss with a strong team effort on the mound and at the plate. Dillon Dingler led the way with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 2-RBI performance, including a 17th home run of the season on a fly ball to center field. Troy Melton earned the win with 5.0 solid innings, while Sean Newcomb impressed with 3.0 scoreless innings, striking out 4 batters. 

**Reds Rout Yankees in NYC**

The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees 10-2 behind a balanced offense and strong pitching. Sal Stewart drove in 6 runs on 2 hits, while Blake Dunn and Spencer Steer also contributed key hits. Andrew Abbott earned the win with 5.2 strong innings, striking out 8 batters. Will Warren also threw 5.2 innings, striking out 8 batters.

**Blue Jays Edge Cubs in Chicago**

The Toronto Blue Jays held off the Chicago Cubs 8-6 behind a strong team effort on the mound and at the plate. Daulton Varsho hit a 1-home run, 3-RBI performance, while Vladimir Guerrero Jr. also contributed key hits. Jeff Hoffman earned the win with 2.0 scoreless innings of relief.

**Padres Outlast Rangers in Texas**

The San Diego Padres edged the Texas Rangers 6-4 behind a strong team effort on the mound and at the plate. Manny Machado hit a 2-hit, 1-home run, 5-RBI performance, while Walker Buehler threw 5.1 strong innings, striking out 7 batters. Adrian Morejon earned the win with 2.0 scoreless innings of relief.
